address.docs:
**int**: Specify the I²C address of the sensor.

*See also: [EZO sensor circuits](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ezo#configuration-variables)*

on_calibration.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: Triggered when the result of `get_calibration()` is ready. The result is provided as a `std::string` variable named `x`.

*See also: [EZO sensor circuits](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ezo#configuration-variables)*
